recentItems.title: Falguni Pathak Garba Songs | Garba Nights | Nonstop Gujarati Garba Hits | Dandiya Songs
recentItems.description:
Enjoy the timeless charm of traditional Gujarati Garba songs by Falguni Pathak. These beloved Garba compositions celebrate the rich cultural heritage, festive spirit, and devotion of Gujarat. Lyrics and compositions are traditional, bringing the authentic essence of Garba to life.

GARBA MEDLEY Credits:

Singer. Falguni Pathak 
Additional Vocals - Tushar Trivedi, Vivian Richard & Parth Pandya
Chorus  Kanchan Soni, Bindu Sailor & Bhavisha Vora
Music  arranged and Programmed by Vivian Richard
Rhythm arranged & conducted by Jatin Pansaniya
Dhol  Mahesh Dangiya
Snare Drum  Jatin Pansaniya 
Live Electric & Acoustic Guitars  Richard Mithra
Roto Drums  Meet Acharya 
High Percussions  Manoj Pandya 
Bass Drums Raju Prabhu 
Live Vocals & Rhythm Recorded by Kunal Dabholkar & Swapnish Jadhav at Sonic Bliss Studio
